title: Request KFT shift report
description: Request the validator to publish a report of all EMV KFT transactions performed within the specified operator shift.

shiftId.description: Identifier of the operator shift for which the KFT report is requested. Must match the `operator.shiftId` provided in the corresponding KFT start messages.

eventTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the report request was issued (UTC, RFC3339 format).
